purpose: Adapters for nineteenth-century embryology and petrography collections recovered through deep search.
guards: Do not convert mixed-period institutional totals into nineteenth-century slide counts.
Preserve parent collection and named historical child-set hierarchy.
Where institutional and scholarly dates differ retain both source layers until object-level dating resolves them.

adapters.target: official historical microscope-slide collections and catalogue discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat Balfour's sections as a named historical corpus and seek item-level slide/catalogue records before asserting totals.

adapters.target: AQUiLA thin-section portal and digitised collection records
adapters.promotion_rule: Filter by date maker provenance and collection series; retain the 30-section Fuess child set separately from the mixed 45,000-object parent collection.

adapters.target: official collection page and downstream specimen database discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Separate microslides thin sections flasks and rock samples; filter named nineteenth-century collectors and expedition material before counting.
